what_happened: The job was meant to build docs/spec.toml, a structured spec of Olympus sections 1-6 of BRIEF.md, plus an xtask test that checks it. The job was rejected with the final verdict "fail: the verifier did not complete: deadline of 1200s reached". All 8 acceptance criteria are listed as unmet. They cover the xtask tests (verbatim quotes, negative cases, requirement counts per section), the content and format of the spec, the open-question record, the policy test, the cargo test/clippy/fmt gate, and the CHANGELOG and decisions entries. No failed checks and no blocker or major findings are listed. The verifier timed out, so none of the criteria were judged and the work was not shown to be wrong.
cause: The verifier runs under one fixed 1200s deadline that does not scale with the work it must do. This job asked it to run cargo test, clippy and fmt, and also to read a large spec against BRIEF.md for coverage of sections 1-6. The verifier has no progress record, no early stop, no resume and no "could not verify" outcome. So a timeout looks the same as a real failure, and every criterion is marked unmet. The same timeout happened before (20261017-034954-52r0) and nothing changed the mechanism. The stored fields do not show why it was slow, so this is an inference.
prevention: Give the verifier a distinct "unverified: timed out" outcome, separate from "fail". It should save per-criterion results as it goes, so the judged criteria stay judged. A retry should resume only the unjudged criteria, with a deadline set from the number of criteria and the cargo gate, or with a reuse of the producer's recorded gate results when the tree is unchanged. A timeout should never reject the job or mark all criteria unmet.
proposed_request: Make verifier timeouts a separate outcome from failure. When the verifier hits its deadline, record each criterion it has already judged, mark the rest "unjudged", and give the job a status "unverified" instead of "rejected". Add a resume path, so that retrying an unverified job runs the verifier only on the unjudged criteria and merges the results. Run the cargo test, clippy and fmt gate once per tree and reuse the result across criteria. Acceptance: a test with a fake slow verifier shows the judged criteria are kept, the job is not rejected, and a resume judges only the remaining ones. Then retry job 20261018-133651-1ncn (docs/spec.toml for Olympus sections 1-6) so it can be verified.
